english: to become, will (future auxiliary), to be (passive auxiliary)
french: devenir, auxiliaire du futur et du passif

english: must, to have to, to be obliged (to do something)
french: devoir, être obligé (de faire quelque chose)

english: shall, to be supposed to, to be expected to
to be allowed (to do something), may
french: être autorisé (à faire quelque chose), pouvoir

english: to make, to prepare, to do
to do, to do something to someone
french: faire, faire quelque chose à quelqu'un

english: to go, to leave, to work, to function (coll.), to be doing (Dat.)
french: aller, partir, fonctionner (familier), se porter (état de santé)

english: to come, to manage (to do something), to get to, to occur
french: venir, parvenir (à faire quelque chose), arriver à, se produire

english: to bring, to take, to lead
to stand, to be located, to be written
french: être debout, se trouver, être écrit

english: to take, to put oneself (in a certain state)
french: prendre, se mettre (dans un certain état)

english: to receive, to get, to catch (e.g. a cold), to be good for someone (e.g. food)
french: recevoir, obtenir, attraper (par exemple un rhume), convenir à quelqu'un (par exemple un aliment)

english: to forget, to leave behind (by forgetting)
to hold, to stop, to support, to keep
to wait, to maintain (e.g. a car)
to know, to be acquainted with, to be familiar with
to offer, to bid, to present itself (refl., of an opportunity)
french: offrir, proposer, enchérir, se présenter (réfl., d'une occasion)

english: to get up, to stand up
to get dressed, to put on, to dress someone, to attract, to pull
french: s'habiller, mettre (un vêtement), habiller quelqu'un, attirer, tirer
